title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・到達

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I don't care how bad the track condition is! I just need to focus on the finish line and run my race!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond finishes in first place! No mud can sully the finest diamond! Just look at that immaculate luster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond was spectacular! I can't believe she beat McQueen! Her talent is undeniable!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Even covered in mud, she stood tall and proud… What a beautiful performance…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhh! Grrr, I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I was in perfect condition! And yet…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: …I guess this just proves how strong you really are, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Looks like I'll need to train even harder from now on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Right. And I'll be doing my best to keep you from getting ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That was a marvelous run, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: McQueen! Thank you for saying so. But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The distance of the race afforded me an advantage. A stayer like you excels at long distances.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That may be true, but I'm the one who chose the autumn Tenno Sho for our match.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I… I want to compete against you in a longer race too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want to defeat you in a long-distance showdown!
That's the spirit, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How's this for an idea?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let's all go head-to-head!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, please! I'd love that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Goodness… You simply want to race Satono too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Was it that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If there are no objections, let's race again at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll be there too! So make sure to vote for me, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! I'm definitely voting for you both! Go Teio! Go McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Then I'm going to enter too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Me too! This will be a blast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The roar of 60,000 spectators shakes the stands. The Arima Kinen will be the race of the century.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Standing among the thunderous cheers of joy reverberating throughout Fuchu Racecourse, refusing to enter the Arima Kinen was never a realistic option.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um… McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Is it okay if I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Why did you decide to race against us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Watching you two compete lit a fire in me. I also considered it my obligation as a member of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Your obligation?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You wish to ask me about how I conduct myself, correct?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. You've become a very illustrious runner through all of your efforts. The Satono family's dream is to have someone like to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I believe you competed against us today because that is how an illustrious runner should conduct themself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, you're exactly right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I take it upon myself to use my incredible talent on proving that the Mejiro family is a prominent part of the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho is a special race both to me and the Mejiro family… I feel compelled to challenge any powerful competitors who excel in it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And that's not all. I will, of course, compete with Umamusume who have proven themselves in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will also accept any challenge from emerging Umamusume like yourself, before proceeding to defeat them with my overwhelming strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And by doing so, the reputation of Mejiro name endures.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is how I choose to conduct myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So you do it to uphold the pride of the Mejiro family…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, the Mejiro and Satono families are in different situations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Your family's reputation within the world of Umamusume originates with you, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is why there are surely paths you can take that differ from my own.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My family's reputation… begins with me…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you, McQueen. I'll try thinking about this some more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: May light guide you along the path you choose. Farewell.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …McQueen truly is so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I really respect her for that unwavering belief she has in her purpose as an illustrious runner!
choice_data_list: I'm glad you could learn something from her.
I'm glad you could learn something from her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Me too! I'm going to follow her advice and think about the kind of Umamusume I hope to become…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'd like to be able to give her my answer when we compete in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Racing in the Arima Kinen may provide Satono Diamond with an answer that'll guide her along the path to becoming an illustrious runner.
